$description: Semantic colour roles: the ONLY colour vocabulary of the UI (bg-canvas, text-ink, border-line, ...). This file declares each role once: what it is for, whether it is a text role (no opacity modifier allowed, so its contrast stays statically checkable) and the contrast it must reach against other roles (WCAG 2.2 AA: text 4.5:1, large text and UI components 3:1). Values live in themes/<name>.tokens.json; the build checks every requirement on every surface of every theme, so a future theme inherits the same gate. Generated from here: ROLE_NAMES, TEXT_ROLES, families (lib/brand/tokens.generated.ts, scripts/brand/generated/roles.json).

surface.$description: Raised containers: cards, dialogs, popovers, menus.

surface-muted.$description: Recessed or alternate areas: alternate sections, inputs, hover backgrounds.

ink.$description: Body text and headings (AAA on every surface).

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text: captions, metadata, placeholders, helper text.

ink-subtle.$description: Large text, icons and disabled content only: 3:1 is not enough for body text.

line.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines (not the only cue of anything).

line-strong.$description: Borders that identify a control: inputs, checkboxes, outlined buttons (WCAG 1.4.11).

primary.$description: Main action fill: primary buttons, selected state, progress.

primary-subtle.$description: Tinted background for selected or highlighted items.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

primary-ink.$description: Text in the primary colour: links, emphasised labels.

accent.$description: Brand sand, decorative only (hairlines, ornaments, illustrations): never text, never the only cue.

accent-ink.$description: Text in the accent colour (a darker sand on light surfaces).

scrim.$description: Translucent veil over photos and behind modals.

shade.$description: Colour of elevation shadows (shadow-1/2/3; not named shadow: text-shadow is a Tailwind utility): dark on every surface, so a raised element casts a shadow even on a dark band. Decorative, never text.

on-scrim.$description: Text over a scrim. Checked with the scrim composited on both a black and a white photo (worst cases).

status.$description: Status roles, one set per tone. <tone> is replaced by each member: danger-ink, on-success, ... The generated StatusTone type lists the members.

<tone>.$description: Solid status fill: badges, icons, progress.

<tone>-subtle.$description: Status background: alerts, banners, tinted rows.

<tone>-ink.$description: Status text on page and on its own subtle background.

on-<tone>.$description: Text and icons on the solid status fill.
